pairs: The words of Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah.
Et factum est in mense Casleu,
And it happened that, in the month of Chislev,
et ego eram in Susis castro.
I was in the capital city of Susa.
et interrogavi eos de Judæis qui remanserant,
he and some men of Judah.
And I questioned them about the Jews who had remained and were left behind from the captivity,
Qui remanserunt, et relicti sunt de captivitate ibi in provincia,
“Those who have remained and have been left behind from the captivity,
in afflictione magna sunt, et in opprobrio:
there in the province, are in great affliction and in disgrace.
And the wall of Jerusalem has been broken apart,
et portæ ejus combustæ sunt igni.
and its gates have been burned with fire.”
And when I had heard this manner of words,
et orabam ante faciem Dei cæli:
and prayed before the face of the God of heaven.
et misericordiam cum his qui te diligunt,
who keeps covenant and mercy with those who love you and who keep your commandments:
and may your eyes be open,
so that you may hear the prayer of your servant,
quam ego oro coram te hodie nocte et die pro filiis Israël servis tuis:
which I am praying before you today, night and day, for the sons of Israel,
et confiteor pro peccatis filiorum Israël,
your servants. And I am confessing the sins of the sons of Israel,
which they have sinned against you.
ego et domus patris mei peccavimus,
We have sinned, I and my father’s house.
We have been seduced by vanity.
et non custodivimus mandatum tuum, et cæremonias,
And we have not kept your commandments and ceremonies and judgments,
et judicia quæ præcepisti Moysi famulo tuo.
which you have instructed to your servant Moses.
Memento verbi quod mandasti Moysi servo tuo,
Remember the word which you commanded to your servant Moses,
I will disperse you among the nations.
But if you will return to me,
etiamsi abducti fueritis ad extrema cæli,
even if you will have been led away to the furthest reaches of the heavens,
I will gather you from there,
et reducam in locum quem elegi ut habitaret nomen meum ibi.
and I will lead you back to the place that I have chosen so that my name would dwell there.’
And these same are your servants
quos redemisti in fortitudine tua magna,
whom you have redeemed by your great strength
sit auris tua attendens ad orationem servi tui,
may your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant,
and to the prayer of your servants who are willing to fear your name.
et da ei misericordiam ante virum hunc.
and grant to him mercy before this man.”
For I was the cupbearer of the king.
